title: Research shows UK young adults would use AI for financial guidance
summary: Research from Cleo AI indicates that young adults are turning to artificial intelligence for financial advice to help them manage their money and develop more sustainable financial habits. The study surveyed 5,000 UK adults aged 28 to 40 and found that the majority are saving significantly less than they would like.
